status: Authored opaque albedo candidate accepted for finite native study; native appearance, distance, world and final art review remain pending

material_controls.vertex_normals_and_tangents: Retained source controls, not generated artwork

seam_fit.operation: tools.asset_pipeline.periodic_rgb on the owned RGB source before resizing
seam_fit.target: mean of each pair of opposite edges

hd_fit.padding: 3 by 3 copies of the owned periodic parent
hd_fit.filter: Pillow RGB LANCZOS with the sample box and default reducing_gap=None

balanced_fit.operation: First tools.asset_pipeline.mip_chain albedo mip, using linear-light premultiplied-alpha BOX filtering and sRGB encoding; convert to RGB

fitting_helper.hash_validation: Verify the parent before decoding and both decoded RGB and encoded output hashes before creating either output. Report bounded hash and dependency diagnostics on failure. Reject linked paths and existing outputs; create each output exclusively.

png_encoding.color_interpretation: Opaque albedo RGB, staged as sRGB. No embedded profile or text metadata.

limitations: CPU comparisons use Point sampling and simple shading. They do not establish native Standard gloss, lighting or mip selection.
The albedo is brighter than the original reference. Gloss and possible highlight clipping require native review.
Complete opaque mip chains preserve geometry coverage, while fine color detail diminishes at coarse levels.
The exact material is shared by shoreline flint, pile states, player equipment, enemy variants, physical projectiles and vendor props. Other materials sharing the texture remain excluded.
Final art and representative hardware performance are not approved.
